theorems.statement: ∀ (n k N : ℕ) (A : Rn n →ₗ[ℝ] Rn N) (K : Submodule ℝ (Rn n)) (S : Rn n →ₗ[ℝ] Rn k) (E : Rn k →ₗ[ℝ] Rn n), Module.finrank ℝ K = k → (∀ z, E z ∈ K) → (∀ z, S (E z) = z) → (A ∘ₗ E).normDet * (S ∘ₗ K.subtype).normDet = (A ∘ₗ K.subtype).normDet
